args.message:
Fix money rounding to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN)

Per FIN-212, round_money should round half to even (banker's rounding).
The tests already expect this behavior; the implementation was using
ROUND_HALF_UP. Switch to ROUND_HALF_EVEN.

args.head: fix/banker-rounding
args.title: Fix money rounding to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN)
args.body:
## Summary

The nightly build fails because `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, per FIN-212), but `src/money.py` was using `ROUND_HALF_UP`.

## Change

- Switched `round_money` from `ROUND_HALF_UP` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` to match the documented behavior and the tests.

## Verification

- CI passed on `fix/banker-rounding` (run `ci-0001`).
